summary: Reads local and UTC system time, then converts UTC time to an internal time format via sub_591EDF. Timezone/DST determination is cached in dword_8D3E58 and reused while the cached system-time copy (xmmword_8D3E60) still matches the current UTC time. Optionally writes the result through an output pointer. Free __cdecl utility, not a member function.

local_names.v5: second UTC SYSTEMTIME used for cache comparison

operations.description: Get UTC system time into SystemTime via GetSystemTime.
Get local time into a second SYSTEMTIME via GetLocalTime.
Cache-hit check: compare minute/hour/day/month/year of the current UTC time against the cached copy xmmword_8D3E60 (byte components 8D3E62/8D3E66/8D3E68/8D3E6A).
On cache hit, reuse the previously computed flag dword_8D3E58.
On cache miss, query timezone/DST data via GetTimeZoneInformation.
Compute DST flag: -1 on GetTimeZoneInformation error, else 1 when return code is 2 (daylight) and both DaylightDate.wMonth and DaylightBias are non-zero.
Refresh cache: store current UTC time into xmmword_8D3E60 and the computed flag into dword_8D3E58.
Convert SystemTime year/month/day/hour/minute/second plus DST flag to internal time via sub_591EDF.
If the output pointer a1 is non-null, write the result to *a1.
